theme_strategy: Light Theme Priority - 'Off-White & Charcoal'. Context: High-end Awwwards-style portfolio requiring a tactile, editorial feel. Dark themes can feel too 'tech-heavy', whereas an organic bone-white base emphasizes the 3D objects and provides a clean canvas.

headings.usage: Massive, expressive hero typography, numbered manifesto chapters, and section headers.

body.usage: Secondary text, UI elements, login page on laptop screen, and small labels.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ (fluid clamp). H2: text-3xl md:text-4xl. Eyebrows/Labels: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.

colors.rules: No pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000). Use 'Tinted Grey' rule. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for all readable text. Provide explicit hover states.

implementation_steps: 1. Canvas Setup: Initialize <Canvas> with a fixed full-screen wrapper (z-index behind or explicitly layered with HTML). Set camera fov to 35 for a cinematic, less distorted look.
2. Scroll Environment: Wrap the 3D scene inside <ScrollControls pages={4} damping={0.2}> from @react-three/drei to bind R3F to the DOM scroll.

3. Laptop Model & Animation: Load a standard laptop GLTF (e.g., using useGLTF). Inside a useFrame hook, read scroll data via const scroll = useScroll() and map scroll.offset to the laptop hinge rotation (e.g., nodes.screen.rotation.x) so it slowly opens as the user scrolls down.

4. The Screen UI: Use the <Html transform wrapperClass='htmlScreen' distanceFactor={1.17} position={[0, 0, -0.2]} rotation-x={-0.256}> component attached to the laptop screen mesh to render the clean, functional React Login Page.
5. The 3D Books: Create a group of books beside the laptop using BoxGeometries or imported GLTFs. Use <Text> or <Html> from Drei to label the spines (e.g., 'About Me', 'Projects', 'Contact').
6. Interaction: Bind onClick events to the books to trigger camera fly-throughs using framer-motion-3d or GSAP, zooming into the specific book to reveal details.
3d_libraries_and_steps.lighting: Use <Environment preset='city' /> for realistic reflections on the laptop screen and metallic parts. Add subtle <ContactShadows> under the laptop and books to ground them.

layouts_and_grids.html_overlay: Use the <Scroll html> component from Drei to overlay standard React/Tailwind sections. Apply the 'Tetris' grid (grid-cols-12, wide gap-8) for HTML content like the manifesto.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12, p-24, py-32 to give the 3D canvas breathing room.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align paragraphs. Use optical alignment for UI. Avoid centering everything to create tension.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle white noise/grain texture overlaid across the entire screen using pointer-events-none and mix-blend-multiply.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use an 'Editorial Ribbon' marquee for tech stack or chapter titles. Slow smooth drift, low contrast.
visual_enhancers.motion: Implement Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. Use Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals on the hero section load.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px border-white/40) for floating navigation elements.

component_usage_rules.marketing_sections: Use raw HTML + Tailwind CSS (div, section) for highly customized, overlapping layouts.
component_usage_rules.login_page_on_screen: Use customized Shadcn UI primitives (Input, Button, Form) heavily styled to fit a minimalist, stark 'terminal' or 'clean tech' aesthetic on the laptop screen.
component_usage_rules.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Light weights) for elegant, high-end iconography.

accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative 3D elements. Provide standard HTML fallback text inside <Scroll html> for screen readers.
accessibility.motion_prefs: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable complex camera fly-throughs if true.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure the login form on the 3D laptop screen maintains high contrast despite 3D lighting conditions.

editorial_portrait_1.description: Elegant woman in white blazer. Use for 'About Me' section revealed from the books.

editorial_portrait_2.description: Minimalist portrait near white wall. Alternative for profile/contact.

texture_grain.description: High-res textured white paper. Use as CSS background image with low opacity for film grain effect.

media_and_images.instructions: Do not use placeholder image services. Apply subtle parallax to HTML images using Framer Motion or Drei's Scroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components and files use `.js` extension, NOT `.tsx`.
Install required dependencies: yarn add three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei framer-motion gsap @studio-freight/react-lenis @phosphor-icons/react

For the laptop model, source a lightweight GLTF/GLB or build a minimal geometric representation if no external asset is accessible. The screen must have an independent rotation axis to animate the 'open' effect.
Use <Html> from Drei on the laptop screen to build the Shadcn-based Login form.
Ensure the books are distinct 3D objects with readable spines. Clicking a book should smoothly lerp the camera to focus on it, while displaying an HTML overlay with the contact/details info.
Keep the aesthetic ruthlessly clean: white/bone background, stark black typography, high-quality lighting.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
